name: FNAL-E-0031
full_name: Fermilab Experiment E31, high-energy antineutrino-proton programme
summary: Fermilab E31 studied high-energy neutrino and antineutrino interactions with free-proton targets in the 15-foot bubble chamber, measuring inclusive scattering and hadron production.
physics_targets: Hadronic multiplicities, strange particles and charm
detection_principle: Charged particles ionized superheated liquid hydrogen, producing photographable bubble tracks. Track curvature, range and decay topology reconstructed the outgoing muon and hadrons; event kinematics tested quark distributions and fragmentation.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: Historical apparatus and published data are documented by the cited experiment publications.

collaboration.name: FNAL-E-0031 Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

results.summary: Measured kinematic distributions compatible with the quark-parton model and found no anomalous strange-particle production in that sample.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
